text.offer: You have proven yourself a disciple of Faren. One of our mages would gladly bring fire and lightning to your side. Ask me for a companion, and they will swear to you by the elements.
text.progress: Stand before Faren's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Fire, ice and storm will answer for you now. Your bond will grow with every battle you share.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before Faren's priestess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
